BUSINESS OVERVIEW

Harbor Logistics, LLC is a port-centric transportation and logistics infrastructure platform based in North Charleston, South Carolina.

The company operates asset-based warehousing, rail transload, intermodal drayage and trucking, fulfillment, packaging, brokerage and export-consolidation services across the southeastern United States. NOVA Infrastructure established Harbor through its December 2021 acquisition of Premier Logistics Solutions and subsequently added ATS Logistics and A&R Bulk-Pak, which combined into the surviving Harbor brand in July 2025. NOVA remains the only disclosed current platform owner; its exact economic percentage and intermediate acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed.

STORY TIMELINE
Jul 1, 2025
Acquisition

Harbor Logistics and A&R Bulk-Pak combined under the Harbor brand, creating a platform with more than 300 employees and over one million square feet of warehouse space.

Jan 5, 2023
Acquisition

Harbor acquired ATS Logistics, adding port drayage, warehousing and customs infrastructure in Charleston.

Dec 2021

NOVA Infrastructure completed the Premier Logistics Solutions acquisition and established the Harbor Logistics platform.

Individual network assets, lender vehicles and passive fund investors remain outside the company boundary.
